chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Discovers the Secret of Eternal Light in Artifact Refining Sect – World of Immortality Chapter 458
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen learns the sentient Martial Ancestor True Scripture has appeared, then uncovers that the War Swords are forged from Eternal Light – the death-essence of multiple Ancestral Gods. A shocking revelation that changes everything.
og_title: The War Swords' True Origin – Eternal Light from Fallen Ancestral Gods
og_description: In Chapter 458 of World of Immortality, Xiao Chen's quest to repair his War Swords leads to the discovery of Eternal Light – a substance born from the deaths of at least ten Ancestral Gods. A world-shattering secret emerges.
twitter_title: Martial Ancestor Scripture & Eternal Light – World of Immortality Ch.458
twitter_description: Xiao Chen learns the Martial Ancestor True Scripture is alive, then uncovers the terrifying origin of the War Swords: Eternal Light from dead Ancestral Gods. The path to reforging them begins.
